propositions: Core must compare only canonical (local-vocabulary) shapes; vendor shapes cross core solely as opaque payloads produced/consumed at port boundaries (OutboundMapper.map_local_to_remote, InboundMapper.map_remote_to_local).
All 8 Jira vendor modules (acli_subprocess, adf, outbound_fields, comment_limits, etc.) must physically reside under adapters/jira/ with loaders repointed and no re-export shims.

Zero vendor reach-through in core: no package-root src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/*.py module may import adapters.jira, use lazy-key literals for adapters.jira, or by-path load vendor siblings (exception: inbound_fields.py pending relocation).

The outbound field and link differs must canonicalize snapshots via InboundMapper and compare only canonical shapes; vendor payloads built exclusively via injected OutboundMapper at emission boundaries.

Remaining open work (canonical-shape outbound field diff, canonical link diff, vendor absence probe behind SupportsAbsenceProbe, reconcile_check.py canonicalization) must make core vendor-agnostic, enabling a second backend implementation via adapters/<x>/ without core rewrite.
